clawbot-communication-organizer.invariant: CLAWBOT (the claw) — the swarms' COMMUNICATION + ORGANIZATION RIB: the swarm writes its artifact (image/report) to its result dir; the clawbot DELIVERS it out of vmem to the operator's DESKTOP folder (pictures/ or reports/), so the operator SEES what the swarms do. Deterministic + $0 (a file copy). Organize by kind, mirror to C:/Desktop/clawbot. When the operator asks for pictures or large reports, the clawbot lands them on the desktop.
